items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Wayne left and was replaced briefly by… Steve Grossman.

ctx.x: George Benson, Joe Beck on Miles in The Sky he was already starting to…

I think there’s a few bootlegs of the band of the band when we were in Europe. There’s one with Miles where out of the blue he starts to play “Milestones” but he plays it like [sings the melody to “Milestones”at a moderate tempo] you should just check it out. Those who research this and hear this, check it out. I forgot the name of it, but it’s at [Juan Pins] in France, near Antibes, France. And Miles plays this really, really hip version, just (at a) moderate tempo and it’s just great what he plays on it!…
